en: Spring Equinox Day and Night are equal.
zh: 春分日白天和黑夜一樣長。
ja: 春分の日は昼と夜の長さが同じです。
local: Spring Equinox Day and Night are equal.
ja_pron: Shunbun no hi wa hiru to yoru no nagasa ga onaji desu.
native: Spring Equinox Day and Night are equal.

en: Around March 21st is the Spring Equinox.
zh: 春分大約在三月二十一日左右。
local: Around March 21st is the Spring Equinox.
ja_pron: Shunbun wa sangatsu nijūichi-nichi goro desu.
native: Around March 21st is the Spring Equinox.

en: On this special day, Daytime and Nighttime are exactly equal.
zh: 在這特別的日子裡，白天和黑夜完全相等。
ja: この特別な日には、昼と夜がちょうど同じ長さです。
local: On this special day, Daytime and Nighttime are exactly equal.
ja_pron: Kono tokubetsu na hi ni wa, hiru to yoru ga chōdo onaji nagasa desu.
native: On this special day, Daytime and Nighttime are exactly equal.

en: 12 hours of light, 12 hours of dark.
ja: 昼が12時間、夜も12時間です。
local: 12 hours of light, 12 hours of dark.
ja_pron: Hiru ga jūni-jikan, yoru mo jūni-jikan desu.
native: 12 hours of light, 12 hours of dark.

en: After today, days will keep getting longer.
zh: 從今天起，白天會越來越長。
ja: 今日以降、日がどんどん長くなります。
local: After today, days will keep getting longer.
ja_pron: Kyō ikō, hi ga dondon nagaku narimasu.
native: After today, days will keep getting longer.

ja: 春はちょうど半分が過ぎました。
ja_pron: Haru wa chōdo hanbun ga sugimashita.

zh: 萬物都綠意盎然，正在生長。
ja: すべてが緑色で成長しています。
ja_pron: Subete ga midori iro de seichō shiteimasu.

en: There's a fun tradition balancing eggs on their ends.
zh: 有一個有趣的傳統是在蛋的尾端立起來。
ja: 卵を立てる楽しい伝統があります。
local: There's a fun tradition balancing eggs on their ends.
ja_pron: Tamago o tateru tanoshii dentō ga arimasu.
native: There's a fun tradition balancing eggs on their ends.

en: People say it's easiest to balance an egg on the Spring Equinox.
zh: 人們說春分時最容易把蛋立起來。
ja: 春分の日に卵を立てるのが一番簡単だと言われています。
local: People say it's easiest to balance an egg on the Spring Equinox.
ja_pron: Shunbun no hi ni tamago o tateru no ga ichiban kantan da to iwareteimasu.
native: People say it's easiest to balance an egg on the Spring Equinox.
